name: @agentic-toolkit/categories
description: The shared category rail: the level-builder hook every markdown surface's hierarchical category browser is built from.
comment:exports: `development` → src for `next dev` (HMR); prod skips it → dist. `./sources.css` is the Tailwind @source self-registration a host @imports once. `./chain` is the rail's reserved URL tokens as a directive-free, server-safe chunk — the `.` barrel is a whole-file 'use client' module, so an RSC that CALLS one of its exports gets a client reference, not a string; see src/chain.ts.

scripts.build: tsup && pnpm run build:types && pnpm run check:directives

comment:directives: `./chain` is the rail's reserved URL TOKENS as a directive-free, server-safe entry. The `.` barrel is a whole-file 'use client' module, so a constant imported from it into an RSC is an opaque client reference, not a string — see src/chain.ts. `chain` imports NOTHING, which is what keeps it unpoisonable; the empty allowlist is that rule, enforced.
